verses.t: 'I am he who shakes the tree (i.e. the tree of the world, which has to be cut down by knowledge). 2. My glory is like the top of a mountain. 3. I, whose pure light (of knowledge) has risen high, am that which is truly immortal, as it resides in the sun.
I am the brightest treasure. 5. I am wise, immortal, imperishable.' 6. This is the teaching of the Veda, by the poet Trisaṅku.
